title: [DISCOVERY V2-Q] Extract ORION-Q structural donors without authority transfer
body:
## Status

**STRUCTURAL-DONOR AND ADVERSARIAL-BENCHMARK LANE UNDER #1282.**

Canonical audit: `research/orion-discovery-v2/ORION_Q_STRUCTURAL_DONOR_AUDIT_V1.md`  
Machine-readable map: `research/orion-discovery-v2/Q_STRUCTURAL_DONOR_MAP_V1.json`

```text
q_paper_authority_transfer = FORBIDDEN_WITHOUT_TARGET_CORRESPONDENCE_AND_VALIDATION
generic_discovery_authority = NONE
physical_quantum_authority = NONE
paper_authority_delta = NONE
```

## Candidate donor families

- TARE/expressivity: registered closure, obstruction, semantic extension versus macro.
- Recursive recovery: negative history, minimum repair, well-founded progress or cycle.
- Dual instrument: partially overlapping information partitions and joint target refinement.
- Typed state: legal transitions, forbidden coercions, responsibility/scope effects.
- Q-max workflows: donor closure, tare/subtraction, prospective held-out execution, resource bounds.
- Q-adjacent exact mathematics: invariant, rank/support/atom, exact certificate and counterexample structure.

These are candidate **structures**, not transferred results.

## Work packages

- [ ] `DISC-Q-DONOR-01`: one `StructureCorrespondenceWitness.v1` per donor family.
- [ ] `DISC-Q-NONCOMMUTE-01`: matched commuting/noncommuting edit-order benchmark.
- [ ] `DISC-Q-MATH-01`: exact proposal-origin and proof-economy benchmark with hidden proof/counterexample.
- [ ] `DISC-Q-INSTRUMENT-01`: minimum-cost target-refining instrument design in a frozen simulator.
- [ ] Add vocabulary-only, post-outcome-map, supplied-grammar, and source-authority-laundering mutants.
- [ ] Prove target-side validity independently of each source Q result.
- [ ] Record broken correspondences and smallest target falsifiers.

## Correspondence gate

A transfer is admissible only when the witness binds:

```text
source and target identities
mapped target-bearing relations
preserved consequences
broken correspondences
target-specific assumptions
smallest target falsifiers
pre-outcome freeze
source and target authority ceilings
```

## Done conditions

Positive terminal:

```text
Q_STRUCTURAL_DONORS_CLASSIFIED_WITHOUT_AUTHORITY_TRANSFER
```

Honest alternatives:

```text
Q_VOCABULARY_SIMILARITY_ONLY
Q_STRUCTURE_DOES_NOT_TRANSFER
Q_TARGET_VALIDITY_CANNOT_CHECK
Q_SUPPLIED_GRAMMAR_ONLY
Q_DONOR_COMPOSITION_SUFFICIENT
```
